_comment: FAMILY ACCOUNTING (#61, SPEC v2.1 §21, basic->advanced): shared family money — who-paid-what, split expenses among family/circle members, a family budget pool + contributions, settle-up ('Dad owes Mom ৳500'), shared bills, per-member view, monthly summary. {key:[bn,en]}: index [0]=bn -> app/lib/l10n/app_bn.arb, [1]=en -> app/lib/l10n/app_en.arb. These mirror VERBATIM the _faStrings table in app/lib/widgets/famacct_strings.dart (Bangla stored there as \u escapes — ZERO Bangla glyphs in any .dart); until merged the section reads them via faStr(). The fa* keys are NEW (48). Category labels (rent/utility/groceries/…) live in widgets/famacct_sheets.dart _catLabels and mirror famacct_engine.BILL_CATEGORIES; fold those in too if you expose them as ARB keys. Placeholders: keys ending in a %s slot (faPaidBy, faPoolCollected, faPoolRemaining, faPoolProgress, faGetsBack, faOwesFamily, faTotalSpent) take ONE already-formatted amount/name string via faStrS — if converted to ICU add {s} + @-metadata to both .arb. REUSED existing getters (do NOT re-add): medForSelf, cancel, save, delete. The '৳' taka sign is a currency glyph emitted by FamAcctLocal.fmtPoisha, not translatable copy. Merge both maps then run flutter gen-l10n.
